description: Want to live in the UAE? Explore the main types of residence visa in UAE and their requirements. Read now to find the ideal visa for your situation!

contentHtml:
United Arab Emirates is firm with its regulations and immigration laws. Knowing which one of the types of residence visa in UAE suits your needs will help you make the correct decision.

In this article, we discuss the eligibility criteria for the different types of residence visa in UAE. We also explain UAE residence visa type to assist you understand them better. Sharing some useful tips for making the right selection among various residence visa types.

Eligibility Criteria for Different UAE Residence Visas

Qualifying for types of residence visa in UAE requires fulfilling the determined eligibility for them. It differs of course with UAE residence visa type.  For the general overview, if it is an employment based visa, there would be two kinds. One will be the standard employment visa. The other being green visa. For standard employment visa, you need to have a valid job offer from a company that is based in UAE, an employment contract and the company should have an authentic trade license. These are some documents ensuring your eligibility for these types of residence visa in Dubai. A skilled worker holding a bachelor degree, a salary of minimum fifteen thousand AED per month and hired on very specific occupation will have one qualified for green visa as one of the employment types of visa in UAE.

Investment based visas are another type of visa that lets one residency in the country. Within the types of investment based visas are golden visa and property investor visa. The requirement for getting a golden visa involved investment in business, real estate or in funds. It includes a specific amount of investment to be made. Entrepreneurs who have some very innovative projects and investors looking to invest in startups also qualify for the UAE Golden Visa. The list of eligibility for golden visa encompasses outstanding students and graduates, doctors, researchers and specialists of their fields. Having ownership of a property worth a specific amount or fulfilling certain property value requirements will have you fulfilling the eligibility requirements of property investor visa.

Other types of residence visa in UAE consist of student visa, retirement visa, and domestic worker visa. Obtaining a student visa calls for getting admission to a recognized educational institution and sharing the proof of financial support. Retirement visa requires people being aged fifty-five or above and owning property or having a specified amount of income. For a domestic worker visa, the eligibility criteria are having been sponsored by a UAE resident and having an employment contract. These visa options highlight some of the key UAE residence visa benefits, offering flexibility for students, retirees, and workers alike.

Work Residence Visa

Among the different types of residence visa in UAE, one of the most important is work residence visa. Usually an employer sponsors it. This lets expat employees work and live in the country. Being eligible for this visa has its own general and specific requirements.

The general requirements including obtaining a valid job offer, having a passport, passing the medical examination and having a clean criminal record. Specific requirements involve job classification, education and experience and salary. There are certain roles that require specific qualifications and work experience. For job classification, your occupation needs to align with the license and business activities of a company. There may be a minimum salary requirement considering your job role and selected option among residence visa types.

Family Residence Visa

Recently, rules for sponsoring a UAE family visa have been relaxed. The general eligibility criteria for these types of residence visa in Dubai for family members involve showing proof of relationship. This can be in form of marriage certificate and birth certificate. Family members are also required to produce a medical fitness certificate.

Freelancer Visa

For attracting skilled professionals to the UAE, the country has introduced the freelance visa in UAE. The Dubai residence visa types for freelancers, general requirements dictate having the relevant educational qualification and sharing proof of income that supports your claim of a certain amount of annual income from freelancing for the past couple of years. It also needs you to prove your financial stability and pass the medical fitness exam.

Specific requirements for this consist of getting a freelance work permit from MoHRE, having the relevant experience in your field and sharing a portfolio that showcases your past work.

Understanding UAE Work Residence Visas

Foreign employees are able to work and live in United Arab Emirates through types of residence visa in UAE. Usually it is sponsored by the employer. Major components of a work residence visa include a valid job offer from a company in UAE, work permit issued by Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation, a MOHRE issued labor card and an Emirates ID.

There are different types of residence visa in UAE. The most common one is the standard employment visa. However there are other options too in the form of green visa and freelance visa. Green visa is aimed at skilled professionals. It offers them self-sponsorship for up to five years. Freelance visa is for freelancers having a certain income threshold.

For getting these types of residence visa in UAE, you will have to go through a visa process. you can involve a service provider like us too. This will make the process smooth and less stressful for you. The process starts with you securing a job offer, your employer applying for a work permit on your behalf and you going through a medical fitness exam. When the work permit is approved, the employer will apply for employment visa from types of residence visa in UAE. After the employee gets residence visa, you can apply for your Emirates ID. MoHRE will issue the labor card linking employee to employer.

Tips for Choosing the Right Residence Visa in the UAE

It is undoubtedly overwhelming to select the right visa. With all the various types of residence visa in UAE being available, it can be tough to choose. But this is a decision that requires a strategic approach not a purely instinctive one. We have some tips here to help you out too.

Start by defining your purpose. Ask yourself if you are seeking employment or looking to start a business. Check if you have the resources to invest in real estate property. See if your plans involve bringing your family to the UAE too.

Assess your eligibility and check the minimum income required for different Dubai residence visa type. Make sure you meet the educational and professional qualifications. You will have to verify the financial status too for moving further in the process with your choice of visa.

Narrow down your options by considering the common types of residence visa in UAE. Employment visa is for those who are employed by a UAE based company. Investor visa is for individuals having an interest in investing in real estate and businesses. Freelance visa is for self-employed professionals. Family visa lets UAE residents bring their spouses and children.
